name: ng-color-picker
title: Color Picker (Angular)
description: Colour picker on an OKLCH area and channel sliders (hue, alpha, lightness, chroma), with a text field in oklch/hex/rgb/hsl, eye dropper, swatches and saved colours. Opens in a Spartan-ng brain popover or renders inline; works with formControl/ngModel. Logic shared with React through @gremorie/color. Mirrors React ColorPicker from @gremorie/rx-forms.
